lines.en: label nodokadorm15:
I knock on Nodoka’s door and wait for-
You know what? Maybe I should just come back tomorrow.
Nodoka isn’t exactly easy to deal with when she’s screaming and knocking things over, and I’ve already had to deal with Yasu at her...Yasu-est recently.
: AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!
But...then again...
The last time I saw Nodoka in her manic state, she was also without pants. And that is a thing I can both respect and appreciate.
Also, I’d feel less bad about her having a spontaneous orgasm on top of me because at least I know she would understand it.
So...fuck it.
I’m going in.
But if I don’t make it out, know that I died in pursuit of something admirable.
scene black
scene nodokacrazy1
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!
: Hey, Nodoka. Nice to see you’re doing well today.
scene nodokacrazy2
: I had it again! The same dream!
: What dream?
scene nodokacrazy3
: The girl! The one with the eyes! The one with the eyes and the hair!
: She was so fucking hot. But who was she? And why? What is the relevance, Sensei? Why does she so often appear to me without saying a single FUCKING thing?!
: What does she know?! What does she know and why will she not tell me?!
: Is she the same one from the writings on the wall?! The same one who plagues the memories that precede my own?!
: I need to fucking know!
: I mean...do recurring dreams always have to mean something?
scene nodokacrazy4
: Fuck you!
: Please don’t throw anything at me. Especially things that you just...generate out of thin air?
scene nodokacrazy5
: The air is not thin. It’s heavy. Heavy with the stench of mystery. Mystery that I, Nodoka Nagasawa, A FUCKING GENIUS DETECTIVE, must uncover.
: Do you want any coffee? You look like you want coffee.
: I’m fine, thanks.
: Are you sure? It’s really good. And if you stare into it beneath the ceiling lights, you can kind of see your reflection.
: Reflections carry hints, you know? Like shadows. Hints that we can use to discover the truth about all of this.
: What makes the world move? Is it the sun? Or is it the strings of a puppeteer pulling us toward a giant ball of hot fucking lava that will one day consume us all?
: It’s-
: Bzzzzzt. The answer is the sun. You’re a teacher. You should know this. But it would be really fucking cool if it was something else, right?
: Uhh...
: So anyway, reflections. Mirrors. Reflections in mirrors.
: If you were to hang yourself upside down and stare into one, would the you that you see be any different from the you that you don’t? Or are you the same in both directions?
scene nodokacrazy6
: Oh! You know what we should do? We should find a mirror. We should find a mirror and go inside of it. We should see what’s inside of it.
: It’s technically possible if we pause reality when all of its atoms are aligned. I can probably time it if you have the supernatural ability to stop time.
: Is that something you have? That’s something I think you have.
: Me? No. But there’s a girl on the first floor who-
: Good! Go get her. Fetch the girl. Bring her here and make her stop time so that I may spend the rest of it searching for the one that I am after.
: It doesn’t really work that way. Also, if you spend your days chasing after someone you saw in a dream, chances are you’re going to die alone and unfulfilled.
scene nodokacrazy7
: That’s why I asked you to stop time, you fucking nuisance! Are you even listening to me?!
So, it’s good that Nodoka’s pants are off. Don’t get me wrong.
But it would be much better if her pants were off and she was being nice to me- which is very much not the case so far.
: Stop thinking to yourself! Share your thoughts with me!
: I was just thinking that I’m glad your pants are off, but that I wish you were nicer to me.
scene nodokacrazy8
: I can be nice. Nice is not a problem for me.
scene nodokacrazy9
: Or at least it wouldn’t be if you’d fucking HELP me already!
: With what? I can barely figure out what you’re even talking about.
: Adventure!
: What?
: We have to go on an adventure! We have to uncover the thing in the thing! The one I need for the thing!
: What thing?
: The fucking thing, Sensei! Do you need me to spell it out for you?!
: Thing! T-H-I-N-G! Thing!
: Come! Now! To the outside world! A large wooden structure awaits us!
: Are you at least going to put on pants first?
: Pants are for the weak! I think better without them! If anything, you should also remove your pants!
: We should go on a pantsless adventure and fuck inside of a mirror!

: If you can figure out how to get in, I’ll let you into me! I’m serious! It would be a fair trade! A tight fit, sure! But I can handle the pain if it means bringing me one step closer to the other side!
: Nodoka-
: Adventure! Penis! Mirror! Eyes! Now!
: I’m good. You can go without me. I don’t really want to risk being seen out in public with a bottomless teenager who looks like she’s on drugs.
scene nodokacrazy10
: You will come and you will like it! I need extra fingers to help me dig! And you have the largest fingers out of anyone I know!
: Uhh...thank you?
: So good for digging! Digging to find what’s buried beneath our feet!
: It is there! I can hear it! I can feel it! It flops around like a fish! A fish with hooks for eyes! A hook with a fish for a mouth!
: Let’s find the fish, Sensei! Let’s catch it and cook it! I’m a detective! I know what I’m talking about!
: Just to confirm, you aren’t actually on drugs, are you? Because I’m beginning to feel a little skeptical.
: No drugs for me! Just thoughts I am infected with! The thoughts of someone else! A second me! One we must collect and dissect!
: Turn around! Face the door! Open it! And walk in a direction you seldom walk in! This is how we find it! This is how we uncover the truth!
scene black
You know, all of that time I’ve spent with Yasu recently is beginning to feel pretty normal by comparison.
It may be consistently more odd being around her, sure...but the thing with Nodoka is that when she’s off, she is off.
And as she forces me out of her bedroom by pushing against my back with all of her strength, I can’t help but wonder if she is acting on behalf of some sort of higher power as well.
I doubt she is, for she seems far too logical to involve herself with such matters.
But whatever is causing this must be far more than the shifting of chemicals inside of her brain.
Whatever is causing this worries me.
scene nodokacrazy11
: Where the fuck are we?
: How should I know? It took all I had to even keep up with you as you stormed your way over here.
: I kind of just assumed you know where you were going.
: I see. I see, I see, I see, I see.
: Then it must be a clue. There must be a reason I came here. There must be a reason I don’t know where I am. And there must be a reason you are here with me.
: I’m just here to prevent anything from happening to you as you are a teenage girl wandering around in the middle of the night in her underwear.
: Stop fucking lying to me. I know you’re just waiting for me to fall asleep so you can take them for yourself. Is that it? You want my underwear?
: Or do you truly want to help me with my mission?
: And...what’s your mission again? Something about digging?
scene nodokacrazy12
: More than just digging! Digging is just one of several means of accomplishing it!
: There is something! I feel it! I must find it! I must snatch up the answers with my own two hands! Wash the dirt off! Return it to the one who needs it most!
: Wait, you’re doing this for someone?
scene nodokacrazy13
: There! That is where we’re meant to go! I remember now! I remember why I came here!
: Follow me to see it all! Such beautiful things! Too beautiful for people like us! Disgusting people!
: People who only live to hurt others! To make memories and pack them away like tools in a box!
: We must dig! We must dig as if our lives depend on it!
scene nodokacrazy14
: Dig! Dig dig dig!
Nodoka storms off, but her voice remains all around me as it echoes throughout an old and unfamiliar school yard.
Her shirt gets caught on a bush that she decides to walk through instead of around.
I don’t worry about whether or not there were any thorns that may have cut her exposed legs open.
I just think about how fortunate I would be if they were to tear her shirt instead and force her into an even greater state of defenselessness.
scene black
scene nodokacrazy15
: X! X marks the spot! But this is the spot and there is no X! Just the shadow of a slanted lower case T!
: I will dig anyway! Dig all night! Dig until I can fuck myself with the exposed bones of my fingers rather than the fleshy bits that surround them!
: Why are you not helping?! We have a job to do!
: Oh...you know. Just...observing the scenery.
scene nodokacrazy16
: The scenery will get you nowhere!
: Why does no one take this seriously but me?! Why am I the one who must endure the brunt of this world’s weight when all I want is to READ!
: There are so many books! So many books and yet I have read them all! We need more books! We need more groceries! Plates of gray food and lavender hair!
: Triangle! Circle! Triangle!
Okay, so Nodoka is officially broken. But at least she is broken in a position that I have imagined her in several times in the past.
I kind of always figured I’d be behind her in a different way once her back arched, though.
I can’t say many of my sexual fantasies involve a girl filling the space between her fingers and her nails with dirt.
I also can’t say that I have any idea how to deal with this. So, at the risk of Nodoka actually digging until there is no skin left on her fingers, I should probably call on someone for help.
Someone who may or may not have experience dealing with this girl in her manic state. And someone not named Otoha since she normally just bails.
scene nodokacrazy17
Thankfully, I know someone just like that. And it’s someone I should have invited along from the get go.
And while she may not have lavender hair, the perfume she wears will compensate for it.
: Hello?
: Hey. What are you doing right now?
: Sensei? You’re calling later than normal today.
: I’m not really doing anything. Is something wrong? Or did you just miss the sound of my-
: I need your help, actually.
: Oh.
: Umm...
: Like...THAT kind of help?...
: What? No. Well, yes. But that can wait until later.
: What I need help with right now is Nodoka.
: Nodoka? Is she in...bad condition again or something?
scene nodokacrazy18
: Well...I guess that really depends on what you mean by “bad condition.”
: Because she looks pretty fine to me.
: Sensei...what I’m asking is if she’s all...“hyperactive” again. I know that sort of thing can happen with her sometimes.
: Well, she is currently digging a hole in the middle of a random schoolyard. So I’ll let you figure out if that’s bad enough condition or not.
: Random schoolyard? Where are you two, exactly?
: I have no clue. I just followed her here. But if you’d like to switch shifts or come here and help me, I’d be totally fine with that.
: Yeah...I’ll head over right away. Can you share your location with me? There should be a button you can press to-
: I know how to share my location, Futaba. I’m not that old.
: Also, can you bring an extra pair of pants when you come here?
: Um...did something...happen to Nodoka’s pants?
: It’s more like there were never any pants to begin with-
: FUCK!!!! WHY IS THE GROUND SO HARD?! WHY DOESN’T IT EVER RAIN?!
: Okay...you know what? I’m going to hang up and get over there as fast I can. Just don’t forget to send me your location, okay?
scene nodokacrazy17
: Deal. Thanks, Futaba.
: Of course. Please keep her safe until I get there. I’ll see you soon.
scene nodokacrazy19
I hang up the phone, send Futaba my location, and stare down at Nodoka- trying my best to avoid having my gaze linger on her ass for longer than it already has.
Unfortunately, I am physically incapable of willing myself to do this. So I watch as she waves it back and forth, throwing dirt behind her as she continues to dig.
Why am I not helping her, you ask?
Because I don’t want to.
Because I’d rather observe.
It’s what Nodoka does best, so I think having her on the opposite side of things for once could be good for her.
: It’s close! So close! I can feel it! I can smell it! And all without your FUCKING help, you useless piece of meat!
: Good job, Nodoka. Hard work pays off, doesn’t it?
: What do you know about hard work?! What do you know when all you do is stand in the corner of the room and dream of the day when you can make a mountain of our bodies?!
: My fantasies aside, Futaba is on her way over so the two of us can drag you back to the dorm.
: I’d likely be able to do it myself if I really wanted to. But, on the off chance anyone sees us, I should probably...not risk that.
: Oh, don’t you worry about that. No one’s going to see you here.
scene nodokacrazy20
: Hi!
if sarasex == True:
: You're becoming a bit of a regular here, aren't you?
: What? I’ve never even-
: You’ve sure picked a strange place to take a half naked girl in the middle of the night, huh?
: I get that “the mood” can strike at the most random of times, but somewhere private would probably make a little more sense, no?
: ...It’s not what it looks like.
scene nodokacrazy21
: My, my, my...what would happen to you if I were to report this to the police?
: You know, if I took a picture of this right now, it’d be pretty hard to weasel your way out of it down at the station, buddy.
scene nodokacrazy22
: Not to mention the state your companion is in. Chances are she wouldn’t even be able to-
scene nodokacrazy23
: Oh.
: Uh-oh.
: Uh-oh? What do you mean, “uh-oh?”
: Ooooooh, nothing...
: Just the teensy little fact that your friend might have just run off since she isn’t there anymore.
: There’s a pretty neat hole, though. I wonder if she found anything cool?

I turn around to find that Nodoka has, in fact, run off- which is doubly concerning because now Futaba is going to think I let her get away when it was really all this girl’s fault for distracting me.
scene nodokacrazy24
: So, now what? You wanna hang out here for a little while longer? Maybe chat about the news and such?
: No...I’m going to go look for the girl I just lost.
: Why? You’re not going to find her.
: She can’t have gone that far. It’s only been a minute.
: Sure. Maybe to you it’s only been a minute. But who’s to say that time moves the same way here as everywhere else?
: For all you know, these could be sacred grounds detached from the construct of time that we let ourselves be gagged and bound by.
: Or...it has only been a minute.
scene nodokacrazy25
: Okaaaaaay. But don’t tell me I didn’t warn you thirty seconds from now when you realize that everything you thought you knew is wrong.
: That-
scene nodokacrazy26
My phone begins to ring and I look down to see that it’s Futaba calling.
And while the most ideal scenario would be that she bumped into Nodoka on the way home and is now escorting her back...I highly doubt that’s going to be the case.
: Go on. Answer it and see how right I am and how wrong you are.
: Hello?
: Sensei?...Are you sure the location you sent me is correct?
: You mean...the one I sent you like two minutes ago?
: Uhh...it's...been a lot longer than that...
: But are you sure it's right? Have you maybe...moved at all?
: No. I haven't moved and I sent you my exact coordinates. Why do you ask?
: Well...it’s just that...
: I can’t exactly...go where you are right now...
: What? Why?
: Because...
: Well...
: It’s outside the barrier...
I hang up the phone and slide it back into my pocket, trying to come to terms with whatever that must mean.
scene nodokacrazy27
: See what I mean? Bet you think I’m pretty neat now, don’t you?
: Who...are you?
: Who am I?
: Yeah. And where are we? And why are you acting so familiar with me?
: Lots of questions there, huh? Does your missing friend not matter to you anymore? You’re more concerned with me?
scene nodokacrazy28
: Well, never fear! For I am also an expert cosplayer and just happened to have a spare pair of that girl’s summer clothes tucked into my socks!
: What-
: You see, I can’t tell you who I am. That would be against the rules.
: In fact, we’re not even supposed to be talking right now.
: But you’ve come to a special place.
: I don’t know how you made it here. Or exactly what your intentions in doing that were.
: But it’s somewhere that some rules become bendable while others stay the same.
: You feel me, dawg?
: Your Nodoka impression could use some work.
: You feel me...incest guy?
: Feel free to imagine that I just said a bunch of really smart sounding stuff there, too. My impression game is normally pretty on point, but that girl’s hard to do.
: You really can’t tell me who you are?...
scene nodokacrazy29
: I really can’t.
: And I’m sorry for that. Truly.
: But the unfortunate truth is that if you knew who I was, you wouldn’t be able to go back at all.
: Why, though?
: Because things have to happen a certain way.
: There’s a certain...order to them, if you will.
: Which is probably why you no longer remember even meeting me in the first place.
: We’ve met before?
: Oh yeah. A bunch of times.
: And we’ll meet a bunch more.
scene nodokacrazy30
: But, for now...I’ll send you off with a smile!
: It won’t protect you from the dimensions you’ll have to slip through in order to make it back to where you belong, but at least you’ll know that this is real.
: And that we’ll meet again the next time things get tricky.
: Wait-
: I can’t.
: I’m sorry.
: But I just-
scene nodokacrazy31
: Sayonara.
: Stop. I just have one more-

scene nodokacrazy10
: Turn around! Face the door! Open it! And walk in a direction you seldom walk in!
: This is how we find the truth!
: This is where we can be free!
scene black
Nodoka and I go on a brief adventure through the various uninhabited floors of the dorms.
I always forget how many there are.
Eventually, she returns home having found nothing.
I do the same.
Along the way, I see a patch of daisies.
And it fills me with an uncomfortable sense of nostalgia.
